teaser: Serverless meant scale to zero and pay per use; now it covers hourly bills. A better name: ephemeral town planner services, and a test for it.
core_idea: Serverless meant scaling to zero, costing nothing idle, starting fast and turning a capability into a commodity, as its definitions said; the word now covers products billed by the hour, so a test (no hourly bill when idle) and a better name, ephemeral town planner services, say what was meant and expose the glue behind services sold as commodities.

Put together, the three words say what serverless was supposed to say, and each covers a part the others miss
